# Chegg

> Chegg is an education technology platform connecting students with learning resources, study tools, and providing advertising solutions for reaching college and Gen Z audiences.

Chegg serves college students and Gen Z learners through its Study Pack offerings and AI-powered tools, while also operating Chegg College Marketing, a programmatic advertising platform for brands targeting the student demographic. The platform emphasizes research-backed approaches to student learning and engagement.

## Key Topics

- Chegg Study Pack
- Gen Z
- College students
- STEM education
- AI-powered learning
- Student marketing
- Programmatic advertising
- Online study tools
- Brand partnerships
- College audience targeting
- Influencer partnerships
- Email campaigns
- User authentication
- Social login
- Sponsored learning
